name: 爱德华·詹纳
bio_short: 英国医生和科学家，被誉为“免疫学之父”。他发明了世界上第一种疫苗——牛痘疫苗（`jenner_vaccine_1796`），成功地利用牛痘预防了致命的天花病毒，拯救了数亿人的生命。
bio_short_en: A British physician and scientist, known as the 'Father of Immunology'. He pioneered the world's first vaccine, the smallpox vaccine (`jenner_vaccine_1796`), successfully using cowpox to prevent the deadly smallpox virus, saving hundreds of millions of lives.
